title: Care for the person doing the work
literal_meaning: Take care of your body while carrying out your religious duty.
explanation: The dictionary places this saying under caring for the body and health. Duty does not erase the needs of the person who performs it. In a wider everyday application, commitment and care for oneself can belong together; exhaustion is not the only measure of sincerity.
meaning_odia: ଧର୍ମକାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିବା ସହ ନିଜ ଦିହକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଜଗିବାକୁ କଥାଟି କହୁଛି। ନିଷ୍ଠା ଥିଲେ ବି ନିଜ ଶକ୍ତି ଓ ଆବଶ୍ୟକତାକୁ ଭୁଲିଯିବା ଠିକ୍ ନୁହେଁ। ଦୈନନ୍ଦିନ କାମରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ନେବା ଓ ନିଜକୁ ସମ୍ଭାଳିବା ପରସ୍ପରର ବିରୋଧୀ ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: The dictionary places this saying under caring for the body and health.
odia_summary: ଧର୍ମକାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିବା ସହ ନିଜ ଦିହକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଜଗିବାକୁ କଥାଟି କହୁଛି।
usage_example: During preparations for a community event, volunteers divide the work so everyone can take a break. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)

title: Embarrassed on someone else’s behalf
odia: ନାଚିଲା ଲୋକକୁ ଲାଜ ନାହିଁ ଦେଖିଲା ଲୋକକୁ ଲାଜ
literal_meaning: The person dancing feels no embarrassment; the person watching does.
explanation: The dictionary explains a mismatch: someone behaves without embarrassment while witnesses feel ashamed on that person’s behalf. The saying can name that uncomfortable distance between an action and how it appears to others. Its image need not be used to condemn dancing or to police someone’s harmless enjoyment.
meaning_odia: ଯେଉଁ ଲୋକ କାମଟି କରୁଛି, ତାକୁ ଲାଜ ଲାଗୁନାହିଁ; ଦେଖୁଥିବା ଲୋକ ତା ପାଇଁ ଅସହଜ ହେଉଛି। ନିଜ ଆଚରଣ ଅନ୍ୟଙ୍କୁ କିପରି ଲାଗୁଛି, ସେଥିପ୍ରତି ଅସଚେତନ ରହିଲେ ଏଭଳି ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ହୋଇପାରେ। ଏଠି ନାଚର ଚିତ୍ର ଅଛି ବୋଲି ନାଚିବାକୁ ଲଜ୍ଜାର କାମ ଭାବିବା ଦରକାର ନାହିଁ।
english_summary: The dictionary explains a mismatch: someone behaves without embarrassment while witnesses feel ashamed on that person’s behalf.
odia_summary: ଯେଉଁ ଲୋକ କାମଟି କରୁଛି, ତାକୁ ଲାଜ ଲାଗୁନାହିଁ; ଦେଖୁଥିବା ଲୋକ ତା ପାଇଁ ଅସହଜ ହେଉଛି।
usage_example: Someone loudly claims credit for a group effort while their companions exchange embarrassed looks. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary explicitly labels the entry a proverb and gives this social-use gloss. Its alternative scatological wording is not needed for this candidate.

title: Breaking rather than bending
literal_meaning: The kaunria stick will break; it will not bend.
explanation: The image makes refusal to yield stark: breaking becomes possible before bending does. Applied to a person, it can sound like admiration for resolve or criticism of costly stubbornness. The words alone do not settle which tone the speaker intends. The object gives that tension a shape without turning every refusal into a virtue.
meaning_odia: କାଠି ନଇଁବା ବଦଳରେ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଯିବ—ଛବିଟି ନଛାଡ଼ିବା ମନୋଭାବକୁ ତୀବ୍ର କରେ। କାହାର ଦୃଢ଼ତା ଦେଖି ପ୍ରଶଂସାରେ ଏହା କୁହାଯାଇପାରେ, ପୁଣି କ୍ଷତି ହେଲେ ବି ଜିଦ୍ ନଛାଡ଼ିବାକୁ ଟାହି କରି ବି। ବକ୍ତାଙ୍କ ସ୍ୱର ଓ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିରୁ ଫରକଟି ବୁଝାଯାଏ। ସବୁବେଳେ ନଇଁବା ଖରାପ କିମ୍ବା ନଇଁନଥିବା ଭଲ ବୋଲି ଏହା କହେ ନାହିଁ।
english_summary: An unbending stick pictures resolve that may become costly stubbornness.
odia_summary: ନଇଁନଥିବା କାଠିର ଛବିରେ ଦୃଢ଼ତା ଓ କ୍ଷତିକାରକ ଜିଦ୍ ଦୁହିଁ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇପାରେ।
usage_example: A collaborator refuses even a small scheduling change until a shared project falls through; a disappointed friend repeats the saying. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
cultural_context: Source gives a fibre-stripped plant-stem sense, not an experimentally verified botanical rule. Keep kaunria name without fixing an independently verified species. Dual social readings are editorial.
